name: Console
description: Dynamically discovers and executes Console API operations published in its CLI manifest. The token is kept by the Cindy host and no CLI binary is bundled.
whenToUse: Use for applications, deployments, clusters, tasks, releases, or on-call resources in Console. Configure a Console HTTPS host and API token first.

list_tools.description: Read the current Console CLI manifest and list the operations, parameters, and request bodies published by that server. Read-only.

call_tool.description: Execute one operation from the manifest. Mutations report executed, not_executed, or unknown; check state before retrying unknown results.

console_conn.label: Console instance
console_conn.hint: Enter the Console HTTPS host and API token. Default HTTPS port only; never put the token in the URL.
